source: British Record (rod-caught) Fish Committee, Angling Trust

Skimmer bream.note: Skimmers are young bream, so this is the bream record.

Common carp.note: The record list has one entry for carp.

Mirror carp.note: The record list has one entry for carp. It doesn't say whether it covers every variety.

Leather carp.note: The record list has one entry for carp. It doesn't say whether it covers every variety.

Ide.note: A joint record, set three times (2000, 2018 and 2021).

Golden orfe.note: The record list counts orfe with ide.

Perch.note: A joint record, set twice in 2011.

Roach.note: A joint record, set in 2006 and 2024.

Brown trout.note: Wild fish. The record for stocked fish is 28 lb 1 oz (1995).

Rainbow trout.note: Fish living wild in a water. A heavier stocked-fish claim was not yet confirmed when the list was published.
